text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Difficult concertos keep coming, one after 
another. Winning sure isn't easy.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
If this losing streak continues... it 
might just turn into a one-of-a-kind 
divertimento.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Just kidding. Naturally, I intend to make 
sure it doesn't come to that.
choice_data_list:
Your running isn't bad at all. Let's keep 
trying until we see results.

Let's learn from this and rebuild your 
fundamentals.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Your words are always as warm as the 
sun.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. We are still merely in a quiet 
intermezzo.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
If we insert a key change here, the 
spettatori will surely be pleased.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I shall deliver a clair 
performance!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
So when you're lost, that's when you go da 
capo, right?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, we must turn that minore 
into a maggiore."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"And our speed is allegrissimo. Fear 
nothing, pick up the tempo!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: To seize the Musica of victory!
